propositions: Only a P8 too-big DET block short-circuits before the LLM passes, so a plan failing the P1 clarity floor still pays the full four-pass LLM review it is guaranteed to fail.
The P8-only short-circuit branch should be widened so any DET-floor blocking finding yields a BLOCK verdict with coverage.llm_ran=False and zero finder invocations.
The BLOCK verdict must carry all DET blocking findings via the same partition_findings/finalize_verdict path.
DET-passing plans must continue running the full LLM passes unchanged.
gate_dispatch requires no change because its degraded/outage path already passes all DET blocks into partition_findings.
Adding a content check to claimability.py was rejected because that seam is deliberately status-only.
